summary: Iter 47 — Post-refactor regression suite (database.py / security.py / services/storage.py extractions from server.py, plus POS/SuperAdmin frontend component extractions). BACKEND: 26/26 pytest cases PASS (1 skipped registry-pdf endpoint not exposed publicly, non-blocking). Verified all 4 auth roles login+/me+refresh+logout, HttpOnly cookies set, wrong-pw 401, protected-without-cookie 401, tenant scoping intact (admin only sees own-tenant staff), manager blocked from require_tenant_admin endpoint (403), image upload+serve, staff CRUD list, attendance/today, staff geo check-in, reports/dashboard + ?branch= filter, /api/public/registry/search returns hire_verdict, POS invoice create, super-admin tenants/overview/engineer-health, no 500s on cross-module PDF endpoints. FRONTEND: SuperAdmin — animated Super-Admin badge, notif bell + HQ Alerts dropdown, all 5 status filter chips (all/active/trial/cancelled/suspended), KPI cards clickable as filters, Leaderboard/Revenue/AI-Engineer/Billing tabs all render post-extraction. POS — AddGuestModal opens (visible with Name/Phone/Email fields), guest search dropdown returns matches, service line added, invoice created (INV-202607-0044), InvoiceReceiptModal renders with Invoice#/Customer/Subtotal/Discount/Total, Print button clicks without JS crash → printInvoice from components/pos/receipt.js works. Smoke: dashboard/staff/attendance/offers-studio all load.

ui_bugs.issue: The rendered receipt dialog does NOT carry the data-testid='invoice-receipt-modal' attribute expected by the review spec. Modal renders and functions correctly (verified visually with INV-202607-0044), but automated tests cannot select it by testid. Add data-testid to the outer modal container.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — coming from a <select> that contains rich children. Cosmetic, unchanged from prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Add data-testid='invoice-receipt-modal' to the root element of components/pos/InvoiceReceiptModal.jsx so automated flows can select it directly. Modal itself works — this is purely a testability nit.
critical_code_review_comments: Module extractions are clean — no import cycles, no missing symbols. server.py imports from database/security/services.storage all resolve; supervisor logs show no import errors after every reload.

iter46 fix on BranchSwitcher role-gate is intact at AppLayout.jsx line 190: `(isAdmin || user?.role === 'manager') ? <BranchSwitcher /> : null`. BranchSwitcher self-hides when tenant has no branches (returns null when branches.length === 0), which is why the miracurl tenant (single-branch) doesn't show a testid on dashboard header — expected behavior.
server.py still 6051 lines even after refactor — cross-iteration debt; not introduced this iter but worth a note.

POST /api/staff uses `get_current_user` (any role) — managers CAN create staff. DELETE /api/staff/{sid} uses `require_tenant_admin` — managers correctly blocked. Behavior consistent with existing RBAC; not a regression.
Invoice payload contract: InvoiceItem.type (not 'kind') is required — worth documenting on the API side. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% — one testid nit on InvoiceReceiptModal, otherwise fully verified

test_credentials: Used super@miracurl.com, admin@miracurl.com, manager@miracurl.com, priya.staff@miracurl.com — all pass. Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 real invoice INV-202607-0044 (Priya Sharma, Henna ₹200) via POS UI test and 1-2 test invoices via API test_pos_invoice_create. Also created + deleted one TEST_denied staff during a scaffolding attempt (deleted via admin session). No stale test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor session is validated. Backend surface fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter47_refactor_regression.py (26 cases). For future runs export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before invoking pytest. If InvoiceReceiptModal testid gets added, uncomment/adjust the corresponding assertion in the frontend playwright block. Do not add cleanup for public registry — search endpoint expects `?q=` (not `?aadhaar=`). Invoice create expects items[].type (not kind).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regression detected. The one testability nit (missing invoice-receipt-modal testid) is a cosmetic gap, not a behavior bug.
